audit.why: TRICKY 7.5/10 fits 57.43% over 249 games — Poppy wins most lane rows but a ranged champion who can refuse the fight keeps it awkward, and Quinn owns the late game.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Quinn, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Quinn, Poppy, Poppy in both layers. The packet has Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Quinn — and every one of the seven whys agrees with the packet, not with the printed side.
audit.why: whys[0] says 'you are both weak at level 1' on a Quinn row, whys[4] says Keeper's Verdict turns her kite into a free reset on a Quinn row, and whys[6] says 'she out-scales you hard' on a Poppy row. The page was arguing against its own chart in five places.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3, 4 and 6 flipped as one atomic paired group in both layers to Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Quinn. Ratings realigned to 5/6/6/5/7/6/3.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability errors. The blind is Blinding Assault (Q, 1025 range, 11-9s), not her E — the page says 'her E blind' and 'fight into her blind' as if Vault carried it. And 'Tag-and-Release' is not a Quinn ability at all; her reposition is Vault (E), her ultimate is Behind Enemy Lines.
audit.why: A player told the blind is on her dash will hold W for the wrong ability and eat a 1025-range Q instead. The invented ability name appears in both a why and a spike, so it renders on the page twice.
audit.corrected: Blind attributed to Blinding Assault with its range and cooldown; the fabricated name replaced with Behind Enemy Lines, which is a channel any of your CC cancels. Vault kept as the dash Steadfast Presence genuinely stops, with its 12-8s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Behind Enemy Lines is flagged as a channel, and Heightened Senses reveals a large area on a 50-30s cooldown.
audit.why: The channel means your E stun or R ends her escape outright; the reveal means bush play against her is not free.
audit.corrected: Both added — the channel cancel to the level-6 row and spike, the reveal noted in the do's.

edits.before: Bait her E Vault — it is her only escape, and the moment she burns it to knock you back you can W to ground a reposition and E her into terrain. Hold W in reserve: it body-blocks her Vault and grounds her if she dashes into it, which is your one answer to her kite. Your Q chunks a percent of her max HP regardless of gold, so even fed she takes real damage every time you connect; at 6 your R yanks her out of a kite or cancels her Tag-and-Release reposition.
edits.after: Bait Vault (E, 12-8s) — it is her only escape, and once she spends it to leap off you she has no exit for the whole cooldown. Hold Steadfast Presence in reserve: Vault is a dash, so W stops it dead, slows and grounds her, which is your one clean answer to the kite. Your Q chunks her max HP regardless of gold, so even fed she takes real damage; at 6 your R punts her out of a kite or cancels the Behind Enemy Lines channel.

edits.before: Quinn's whole game is never letting you press E, so fight near your own wall where any Vault knockback or Harrier dash sticks her against terrain for a free Heroic Charge stun. At level 1 you both want to farm — don't chase her into open lane where her Harrier nimble move speed kites your autos forever. Once you hit 2-3, threaten a quick E-into-wall combo whenever she steps up to last-hit, and use W's passive armor/MR to shrug off her poke.
edits.after: Quinn's whole game is never letting you press E, so fight near your own wall where a spent Vault leaves her against terrain for a free Heroic Charge stun. edits.before: This is where she takes the lane back — 2+ items of Harrier crits and her splitpush mean she kites you in open ground and you can't catch her without a perfect wall E. Your flat damage doesn't scale, so don't try to solo-duel a fed Quinn in the open; group with your W as a dash-deny frontline and let your percent-HP Q matter in teamfights instead. Win the early-to-mid windows hard so her scaling never gets the chance to embarrass you 1v1.

notes: No mirror existed for this matchup, so the findings here are first-hand. Killed a fabricated ability: 'Tag-and-Release' is not in Quinn's kit and appeared in both whys[4] and spikes[1] — her ultimate is Behind Enemy Lines, and it is a channel your CC cancels. Also moved the blind onto the right slot: Blinding Assault is Q at 1025 range on 11-9s, not part of Vault. The chart was wrong in five of seven rows while every why on the page already described the packet's answer; flipped as one atomic paired group. The full layer calls Quinn 'him/his' in tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, breakdown.feeding and several report entries — fixed where edited, the rest needs a champion-wide sweep. Genuinely correct and worth keeping: Vault is a dash, so Steadfast Presence really does stop it.
